title: Decompose and Compare Consistency: Measuring VLMs’ Answer Reliability via Task-Decomposition Consistency Comparison

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing consistency between a Vision-Language Model's (VLM) direct answer and reasoned answers generated by both the VLM itself and an independent Large Language Model (LLM) to detect and mitigate self-reinforcing reasoning errors.

Analyzing the distribution and diversity of generated sub-question types (e.g., yes/no, what, where) to ensure the evaluation does not inherit known VLM response biases, such as the tendency to default to 'yes' for yes/no queries about non-existent objects.
